title: Cheeky's Prank Goes Wrong
reason: Remove unsafe tail-tying and the ending that rewards another prank; preserve simple cause and effect while teaching Cheeky to notice feelings, apologise, repair the mess, and plan humour everyone can enjoy.

pages.1: Cheeky wanted to make the Dino Pals laugh. "I need a funny surprise," he said.
pages.2: Cheeky hid beside the path. He put a soft leaf hat on a low branch for Wiggly to find.
pages.3: Wiggly found the hat. It fell over his eyes. Cheeky laughed, but Wiggly did not.
pages.4: Next, Cheeky spread mud on Fancy's favourite rock. Fancy sat down. "Oh!" cried Fancy.
pages.5: Cheeky laughed and stepped back. He slipped in the mud. Now he was muddy too.
pages.6: The Dino Pals helped Cheeky up. "My jokes hurt your feelings," he said. "I am sorry."
pages.7: Cheeky asked Wiggly and Fancy, "What makes you laugh?" They made silly faces together.
pages.8: Cheeky cleaned Fancy's rock. Then the friends planned a joke everyone could enjoy.
